results.text: Earthquake: Dexterity check or fall prone. 1–2 on [[/r 1d6]] unearths a new dungeon opening ([[/r 1d6]]: 1–2 Natural Cave, 3 Ruined Arch, 4–5 Sealed Crypt, 6 Sewer).
Rockslide: Deals [[/r 1d4]] damage per average party level (rounding down); Save vs. Breath/Paralysis for half.
Sinkhole: Constitution check to avoid sliding down (+1 cumulative penalty each subsequent round). Natural 20 sucks PC down immediately (lost unless exit exists).
Sandstorm: Visibility reduced to zero. 80% chance party veers off course; movement slows to 1/4 unless halted.
Acid Rain: Lasts [[/r 2d4]] rounds; deals [[/r 1d4]] damage/round per character level to exposed flesh (metal and clothing unaffected).
Insect Plague ([[/r 1d6]]): 1–3 Locusts, 4–6 Beetles. Dig a hole, cover up, or light torches and huddle together or be swept into a random adjacent hex.
Meteor Shower: Pulverizes the hex; PCs take [[/r 1d6]] damage per level.
Temperature Change: Flash snowstorm or scorching heat (same effect as Freeze/Heat Metal) for 10 hours; movement slowed to half.
